editorial_thesis: Use newly native agent interfaces to make client-facing intelligence more grounded, code review more context-aware, and interactive assistance more measurable.

topic_groups.title: Grounded Retrieval Framework Bridges

sources.title: Use AI Search with the Agents SDK, AI SDK, and LangChain
sources.why_selected: Today’s release makes Cloudflare AI Search directly usable from three popular agent frameworks.
sources.usefulness: A portable path to cited retrieval without hand-writing REST integration.

sources.title: AI Search + Vercel AI SDK guide
sources.why_selected: Shows AI Search as a chat model and as a callable search tool within AI SDK flows.
sources.usefulness: Prototype a client knowledge assistant while keeping citations in the response path.

sources.title: AI Search + LangChain guide
sources.usefulness: Useful where existing client workflows already use LangChain retrieval chains.

topic_groups.selection_rationale: Cloudflare shipped first-party AI Search guides for three agent ecosystems today. This is a practical coverage gap: retrieval can now sit behind the same framework interfaces used for Buildn and client agents, with sources returned to the calling workflow.

topic_groups.title: Review Context + Code Scanning

sources.title: Copilot code review: Agent skills and MCP now generally available
sources.why_selected: Agent skills and MCP connections are now GA in Copilot code review, with read-only tool calls and attribution.
sources.usefulness: Turn client-specific review standards into a visible, auditable PR control.

sources.title: CodeQL 2.26.1 improves analysis accuracy and framework coverage
sources.why_selected: New modeling improves Go, Java/Kotlin, JS/TS coverage and reduces Rust false positives.
sources.usefulness: Directs teams to inspect new SSRF and origin-check findings rather than treating upgrades as background noise.

sources.title: Default model enablement for Copilot Business and Enterprise
sources.why_selected: A global policy can govern which generally available Copilot models are enabled.
sources.usefulness: Keeps model availability separate from repository review controls and pilot policy.

topic_groups.selection_rationale: GitHub’s July 29 releases make code review more context-aware while improving static-analysis coverage. The material update is GA support for skills and read-only MCP in review, distinct from yesterday’s supply-chain prevention coverage.

topic_groups.title: Realtime Client Interfaces

sources.title: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 now available on AI Gateway
sources.why_selected: A speech-to-speech model is exposed through a gateway with routing, observability, spend controls, and failover.
sources.usefulness: A bounded way to test voice intake or client-facing assistance without shipping provider keys to browsers.

sources.title: AI Gateway adds unified fast mode support
sources.why_selected: Fast serving can be requested on a base model with fallback to standard routing.
sources.usefulness: Lets an operator measure whether responsiveness is worth its per-token premium by workflow class.

sources.title: Realtime voice, speech, and transcription now supported on AI Gateway
sources.why_selected: The gateway’s realtime surface supports voice, speech generation, and transcription through a common API.
sources.usefulness: Supports a controlled comparison of voice intake, transcription, and text fallback in one product prototype.

topic_groups.selection_rationale: Two July 29 Vercel releases make low-latency agent interaction easier to route and instrument: a speech-to-speech model via a gateway and provider-neutral fast mode. This opens a client-experience lane that has been under-covered relative to back-office agents.
